parameters.name: bookingExtendOption
parameters.description:
Controls which booking extension logic is applied when the project dates change.
UpdateBookingDatesOnly — only bookings ending exactly on the previous project end date have their end date moved.
On prolonging, no new planning entries are generated.
On shortening, planning entries beyond the new end date are zeroed out and removed (weekly, daily, and monthly).
RedistributePersonDays — bookings ending within the last week of the previous project end date (within 6 days) are moved and their total person days are redistributed evenly over the new period by overwriting all planning entries with a uniform weekly capacity.
UpdateBookingsAndPlanning — bookings ending within the last week of the previous project end date (within 6 days) are extended or shortened and planning entries are updated using the existing capacity pattern.
When omitted, nothing happens, only project end date is updated.

this capacity and the booking's StartDate/EndDate using the standard working-time conversion

dailyPlanning.description:
An optional list of daily planning entries.
Entries with a planned time will be added if missing or will overwrite existing planning data.
Entries with zero planned time will be removed.
Any planning days that are *not* provided will be left unchanged.
Cannot be combined with Decidalo.Import.Host.Contracts.BookingBatchInput.BookingInput.WeeklyPlanning on the same booking.

weeklyPlanning.description:
An optional list of weekly planning entries, expressed in hours per week (HoursPerWeek).
Each entry's DateInWeek may be any date within the target week — it is normalized to that
week (Monday-based) when applied. Entries with a planned effort overwrite existing
planning for that week; entries with zero effort remove it. Weeks that are *not* provided
are left unchanged. The weekly effort is distributed across the week's working days, taking
the candidate's working profile and absences into account.
Only one of Decidalo.Import.Host.Contracts.BookingBatchInput.BookingInput.DailyPlanning, Decidalo.Import.Host.Contracts.BookingBatchInput.BookingInput.WeeklyPlanning or
Decidalo.Import.Host.Contracts.BookingBatchInput.BookingInput.MonthlyPlanning may be provided on the same booking.

monthlyPlanning.description:
An optional list of monthly planning entries, expressed in hours per month (HoursPerMonth).
Each entry's DateInMonth may be any date within the target month — it is normalized to that
month (first-of-month) when applied. Entries with a planned effort overwrite existing
planning for that month; entries with zero effort remove it. Months that are *not*
provided are left unchanged. The monthly effort is distributed across the month's working days,
taking the candidate's working profile and absences into account.
Only one of Decidalo.Import.Host.Contracts.BookingBatchInput.BookingInput.DailyPlanning, Decidalo.Import.Host.Contracts.BookingBatchInput.BookingInput.WeeklyPlanning or
Decidalo.Import.Host.Contracts.BookingBatchInput.BookingInput.MonthlyPlanning may be provided on the same booking.

holidayListCode.description:
The combination of Country and subdivision codes separated by a hyphen which determine the usual list of Holidays of the User.
The part preceeding the hyphen is the country code according to the ISO 3166-2 standard and the part succeeding it is the code of the region according to ISO 3166-2 standard.
Example: DE-NI corresponds to the list of holidays in the region NiederSachsen of Germany.
The first part that is DE is the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 standard nomenclature for Germany.
The second part that is NI denotes the ISO 3166-2 standard nomenclature for NiederSachsen.
Note that the ISO 3166-2 nomenclature for certain regions maybe numeric. For example: AT-6 denotes holidays in Steiermark in Austria.
Also one can have a code without any subdivision Code. For example: DE which would then represent the list of holidays in Germany. 
DE being the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 standard nomenclature for germany.
